newsitem.title: FRANCE: Paribas sells 70 pct Dutch unit to Bacob.
newsitem.headline: Paribas sells 70 pct Dutch unit to Bacob.

text.p: French holding company Paribas plans to sell 70 percent of Paribas Nederland unit to Belgian cooperative bank Bacob-Arco, the French firm said on Tuesday.
The sale follows Bacob's decision in May to buy Bank Paribas Belgium and will give Bacob 100 percent control of Paribas Nederland. Bank Paribas Belgium holds the other 30 percent.
A joint statement from Paribas and Bacob-Arco said the two firms had just signed a memorandum of agreement on the transfer of control of Paribas Nederland.
The statement did not specify the price of the transaction but a spokeswoman for Paribas said that the company would realise a capital gain on the sale.
Paribas Nederland's main activities are commercial banking for medium-sized Dutch companies and asset management for private individuals. In 1996 it made a profit of 27.3 million guilders.
